content.description: The whole lesson: what was tried, what happened, what worked and when it applies. At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

applicability.description: Reusable when omitted: any later task can find it, with or without an open work session. Project or task narrows it to the acting work session's project or task. Notes stay private to this identity and plugin.

supersedes.description: ID of one of your current notes that this note corrects, in the same applicability. A stale or foreign target is refused.

sequence.description: Positive canonical decimal record sequence, encoded as a string.

incarnation.description: Source incarnation of the cited record.
